item.title: Public Consultation Opens on The Future of Highland Play Areas
item.description: Highland residents are being invited to share their views as a public consultation opens on the future of play areas across the region, with a new assessment set to guide long term planning, accessibility, and investment in outdoor play spaces.The post Public Consultation Opens on The Future of Highland Play Areas appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Westminster Parties in Turmoil as SNP Claims Stability Ahead of Holyrood Vote
item.description: As the Holyrood election approaches, the SNP says growing turmoil within Labour, Conservative and Reform ranks is sharpening the contrast with Scotland’s devolved government, with new polling suggesting John Swinney’s party remains firmly in the lead.The post Westminster Parties in Turmoil as SNP Claims Stability Ahead of Holyrood Vote appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Football Delivers £820m Boost to Economy New Research Finds
item.description: Scottish football is delivering a major boost to the national economy, with new independent research showing the game contributes £820m and supports more than 14,000 jobs, highlighting the growing impact of clubs, supporters, and national teams across Scotland. The post Scottish Football Delivers £820m Boost to Economy New Research Finds appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Motorcycle Safety Measures Approved for A939 Between Grantown and Nairn
item.description: New motorcycle safety measures are being installed on the A939 between Grantown and Nairn after council approval, with PRIME signage and road markings aimed at reducing collisions and encouraging safer riding behaviour on one of the Highlands’ most popular routes.The post Motorcycle Safety Measures Approved for A939 Between Grantown and Nairn appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: High Life Highland Roadshows Bring Leisure Centres to Communities
item.description: High Life Highland is bringing its leisure centres directly to communities with a new series of roadshows, giving people the chance to explore local facilities, ask questions, and discover affordable ways to support their health and wellbeing.The post High Life Highland Roadshows Bring Leisure Centres to Communities appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Connor Burns Brings Gallus to Eden Court This Week
item.description: One of Scotland’s fastest rising comedy stars is in Inverness this week as Connor Burns brings his brand new show Gallus to Eden Court, delivering a bold, fearless hour of stand up that has critics raving and audiences scrambling for tickets.The post Connor Burns Brings Gallus to Eden Court This Week appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ducati Unveils Centenary MotoGP Machines as Márquez and Bagnaia Chase History
item.description: Ducati has unveiled its 2026 MotoGP machines in a special centenary livery as Marc Márquez and Francesco Bagnaia prepare to chase new records, marking 100 years of Ducati racing heritage with ambitions firmly set on more titles.The post Ducati Unveils Centenary MotoGP Machines as Márquez and Bagnaia Chase History appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Bus and Cycle Shelters Roll Out Across Orkney
item.description: New bus and cycle shelters are being installed across Orkney following Scottish Government funding, with upgrades designed to support public transport use, improve real time travel information, and encourage active travel in communities across the islands.The post New Bus and Cycle Shelters Roll Out Across Orkney appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Royal National Mòd Delivers £3.9m Economic Boost for Lochaber
item.description: The Royal National Mòd 2025 delivered a £3.9 million economic boost for Lochaber, supporting jobs, local businesses, and Gaelic culture, with new research highlighting the festival’s lasting social, cultural, and economic impact across the region.The post Royal National Mòd Delivers £3.9m Economic Boost for Lochaber appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Questions Mount Over Scottish Labour Campaign as Sarwar Faces Fresh Scrutiny
item.description: Scottish Labour is facing mounting scrutiny after a series of campaign controversies involving fabricated quotes and unauthorised images, with Anas Sarwar now reported to the Electoral Commission as questions grow over trust, consent, and campaign standards.The post Questions Mount Over Scottish Labour Campaign as Sarwar Faces Fresh Scrutiny appeared first on The Highland Times.
